candidate.answerReason: Profit is 25% of the 80-yuan cost, or 20 yuan, so the selling price is 100 yuan.

methods.label: Find profit and add it to cost
methods.explanation: Profit = cost price × profit rate = \(80\times25\%=20\) yuan. Selling price = cost price + profit = 100 yuan.
methods.levelReason: Uses percentage multiplication and addition, within grade 6 prerequisites.
